item.title: Organizational culture as an explanation for job search effort across small, medium, and large firms
item.description: This study examines whether organizational culture influences employees to seek alternative job opportunities and explores the moderating effect of firm size on the relationship between organizational culture and job search effort. item.title: The use of different cost of equity models when valuing SMEs: A case study
item.description: This study examines the valuation process of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), using a Portuguese SME as a case study. The analysis focuses on calculating the cost of equity, with particular attention to the unique characteristics of these companies. item.title: Drivers of SME customer relationship management: Perspectives from owners/managers
item.description: The relationship between managerial perceptions of customer relationship management (CRM) and actual CRM practices within organizations remains unclear, particularly in the context of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) operating in developing market economies.
